scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Sales teams waste 3 days per week on admin and meetings instead of selling (intensity 8/10, stage: Activity Execution) ← flagged as binding
2. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] NetSuite-Salesforce integration failed after 9 months, causing data silos (intensity 9/10, stage: Order Processing) ← flagged as binding
3. [DataSignalFriction] Sales reps lack customer intelligence and need manual information from customer care before visits (intensity 7/10, stage: Pre-Visit Intelligence) ← flagged as binding
4. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] 90+ Salesforce customizations making standard implementations complex and unstable (intensity 8/10, stage: Customer Engagement) ← flagged as binding
5. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] Distributors becoming order-takers instead of proactive sellers due to lack of tools (intensity 6/10, stage: Proactive Selling Development)
6. [GovernanceRiskFriction] CRM activity metrics not enforced due to system reliability concerns (intensity 7/10, stage: Performance Tracking)
